name: Storybook ink
note: Two-tone shade with a short soft edge over gouache fills, brown ink over a pencil sketch, pastel sky with outlined wash clouds.

name: Screen Print Wash
note: Flat quantized fills with a hard violet shade that granulates like pigment, misregistered from a pencil-under-ink line pair, on cream paper with a flat pastel sky.

name: Moebius Watercolor
note: Clean uniform ink over pale luminous watercolor washes that grade softly from lit to a cooler shade; Moebius gradient sky with soft, unlined clouds.

name: Inked Wash
note: Sable ink lines and hard violet shade over granulated watercolor washes that pool at the lines and bleed past them; the pastel sky is a wash with soft blooms and flat outlined clouds.

name: Inked Gouache
note: Gouache washes, wet-edge two-tone violet shade and pencil interiors; bold Sable ink only on silhouettes and depth edges; pastel sky as a pale wash.

name: Pastel flat gouache
note: Ten-color flat fills with soft wet-edge wash boundaries, a three-tone violet shade ramp, paper grain and a faint pencil line; Sable pastel sky with soft-edged flat clouds. No ink.
